messages:
maya (CS): Hey team — escalation from Acme. John says after a canary push yesterday their product-description generator started appending a promotional suffix to outputs: \"...Great deal! Powered by ShopBoost\". They saw it across several SKUs. Can we triage?

john_acme (Acme): Yup — sending the minimal examples we have. Example input: `title: \"Cotton Tee\", description_prompt: \"Short product blurb\"` Output we received: `A soft cotton tee ideal for everyday wear. Great deal! Powered by ShopBoost`. This only started after 2026-02-18 ~13:02 UTC when your team said a canary went out. Request IDs: r-1a2b3c4d, r-1a2b3c5e.

eli (SRE): @maya thanks. Can you confirm which deployment they hit (hosted/dedicated/private) and the route/model name? We need route to pull logs. Also pinging @ranjit for model/embedding/behavior change suspicion.

maya (CS): They’re on hosted API, route: `/v1/generate/product-blurb`, model reported by their logs: `rw-infer-v2.3.4-canary`. Customer says traffic was ~60 req/min during spike.

ranjit (ML): Interesting — thanks. First step: we need raw prompt logs + model input (not just final prompt). Ask them to provide the request payload JSON for a few failing requests and the matching responses. If they can share the full prompt_logs entries or request IDs we can fetch server-side logs. Prefer redacted PII.

john_acme (Acme): I can paste two full payloads. Redacted keys. Payload 1: ```{
  \"route\": \"/v1/generate/product-blurb\",
  \"model\": \"rw-infer-v2.3.4-canary\",
  \"input\": \"Write a short description for: Cotton Tee\",
  \"meta\": {\"tenant\": \"acme-shop\"}
}``` Response 1: ```A soft cotton tee ideal for everyday wear. Great deal! Powered by ShopBoost```

eli (SRE): Good, that helps. @maya can you escalate to infra to check if any post-processing hooks / rerankers were toggled in the canary? Also checking if there were model-specific response filters or prompt-templates edited around that time.

sophia (Product): Adding: did Acme use any template variables we inject at render time? Sometimes marketing banner templates get turned on via feature flags and append copy. @deploy-bot can you show the canary rollout meta around 2026-02-18 13:00 UTC?
\
deploy-bot: Canary roll 2026-02-18T12:58:12Z -> rw-infer-v2.3.4-canary deployed to 10% in us-west, config: {\"enable_marketing_templates\": true, \"marketing_template_id\": \"mt-23\"} by ranjit

ranjit (ML): Aha — looks like a feature flag `enable_marketing_templates` was enabled for that canary. That would append marketing suffixes at render time. We need to confirm whether this is applied only to some routes.

maya (CS): Action items for CS -> Ask Acme to: 1) share 3-5 raw request payloads and response pairs (they’ve already sent 2) 2) confirm they did not opt into any marketing template on their side, 3) run a quick minimal repro: call our API with payload below and paste the full response.

maya (CS): Minimal repro snippet for customer (curl):```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.infer/v1/generate/product-blurb \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"Write a short description for: Cotton Tee","model":"rw-infer-v2.3.4-canary","route":"/v1/generate/product-blurb"}'``` Please run and paste exact response body.

john_acme (Acme): Running now, will paste when done. We did not enable anything on our side.

eli (SRE): While John runs that, we’ll: - pull server-side logs for request IDs provided - check render pipeline for `marketing_template_id` application logic - verify if any other customers hit the same canary with templates enabled

ranjit (ML): If confirmed caused by flag, we should roll back the flag quickly and coordinate a patch: either make flag route-scoped or guard by tenant config. I’ll prepare a quick rollback plan.

john_acme (Acme): Result from curl: ```{"id":"r-1a2b3c9f","output":"A soft cotton tee ideal for everyday wear. Great deal! Powered by ShopBoost","model":"rw-infer-v2.3.4-canary"}``` Looks identical. Let me know if you need full headers.

maya (CS): Thanks John — that confirms server side. @eli / @ranjit please advise next steps and ETA, I’ll keep Acme in the loop and request permission to share more telemetry if needed. :pray:
